Query:
UNLOAD (SELECT bs."in.geometry_building_type_recs" AS geometry_building_type_recs, sum(1) AS metadata_rows_count, count(distinct(bs.bldg_id)) AS model_count, sum(bs.weight) AS units_count, sum(MAP(ARRAY['Mobile Home', 'Single-Family Detached', 'Single-Family Attached', 'Multi-Family with 2 - 4 Units', 'Multi-Family with 5+ Units'], ARRAY[0.5, 1.0, 0.8, 0.6, 0.4])[bs."in.geometry_building_type_recs"] * bs.weight) AS bldg_load_factor FROM resstock_2024_amy2018_release_2_metadata AS bs WHERE bs.applicability = true AND bs.upgrade = 0 AND bs."in.state" = 'CO' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1) 
 TO 's3://resstock-core/bsq_athena_unload_results/501ba64252a68e4afa3e84140ff846b4d043a68c6d365e2fb8a55c8295bd2e51/a591839b-981b-4e0e-bfdc-f85aed4cd9b3/'
